1087	    """Pick the CUDA sparse-MLA attention class for the configured backend.
1088	
1089	    The generic CUDA backend selector does not instantiate DSv4 layers directly,
1090	    so map generic sparse-MLA choices to the DSv4-specialized attention class.
1091	    Without an explicit backend, SM12 defaults to FlashInfer while the other
1092	    CUDA arches keep the FlashMLA path.
1093	    """
1094	    backend = vllm_config.attention_config.backend
1095	    device_capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
1096	    if backend in (
1097	        AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE,
1098	        AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120,
1099	    ):
1100	        raise ValueError(
1101	            f"{backend.name} is not a DeepSeek V4 attention backend. "
1102	            "Use FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4 for DeepSeek V4 FlashInfer "
1103	            "sparse MLA."
1104	        )
1105	    if backend == AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4:
1106	        if device_capability is not None and device_capability.major == 12:
1107	            return DeepseekV4FlashInferSM120Attention
1108	        return DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention
1109	    if backend in (
1110	        AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHMLA_SPARSE,
1111	        AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV4,
1112	    ):
1113	        return DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
1114	
1115	    if device_capability is not None and device_capability.major == 12:
1116	        return DeepseekV4FlashInferSM120Attention
1117	    return DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention

1644	    @staticmethod
1645	    def _pad_shared_expert_weight(
1646	        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
1647	        name: str,
1648	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
1649	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
1650	        """Zero-pad a block-FP8 shared-expert weight/scale on its intermediate
1651	        axis so the standard TP loaders split it into even, block-aligned shards
1652	        (trailing ranks get the zero pad). gate (w1)/up (w3) [I, H] pad dim 0;
1653	        down (w2 -> down_proj) [H, I] pads dim 1.
1654	        """
1655	        block_size = getattr(quant_config, "weight_block_size", None)
1656	        assert block_size is not None
1657	        # Round the intermediate axis up to a whole number of TP shards. The axis
1658	        # is in elements for weights (step = block) and in blocks for scales.
1659	        step = 1 if name.endswith("weight_scale_inv") else block_size[0]
1660	        dim = 1 if ".down_proj." in name else 0
1661	        mult = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size() * step
1662	        pad = cdiv(loaded_weight.shape[dim], mult) * mult - loaded_weight.shape[dim]
1663	        if pad == 0:
1664	            return loaded_weight
1665	        pad_shape = list(loaded_weight.shape)
1666	        pad_shape[dim] = pad
1667	        return torch.cat([loaded_weight, loaded_weight.new_zeros(pad_shape)], dim=dim)

1703	def _make_deepseek_v4_weights_mapper(expert_dtype: str) -> WeightsMapper:
1704	    if expert_dtype == "fp4":
1705	        # MXFP4 experts use Mxfp4MoEMethod, which registers scales as
1706	        # ``w{1,2,3}_weight_scale`` (no _inv suffix). FP8 linear and
1707	        # shared experts use Fp8LinearMethod's block scales, which
1708	        # register as ``weight_scale_inv``.
1709	        scale_regex = {
1710	            # ``.base_layer.``-namespace variant (LoRA-wrapped experts).
1711	            re.compile(
1712	                r"(\.experts\.\d+\.w[123]\.base_layer)\.scale$"
1713	            ): r"\1.weight_scale",
1714	            re.compile(r"(\.experts\.\d+\.w[123])\.scale$"): r"\1.weight_scale",
1715	            re.compile(r"\.scale$"): ".weight_scale_inv",
1716	        }
1717	    else:
1718	        # FP8 experts use Fp8MoEMethod (block_quant=True), which registers
1719	        # scales as ``w{13,2}_weight_scale_inv``. Map all ``.scale`` keys
1720	        # there.
1721	        scale_regex = {
1722	            # ``.base_layer.``-namespace variant of the above.
1723	            re.compile(
1724	                r"(\.experts\.\d+\.w[123]\.base_layer)\.scale$"
1725	            ): r"\1.weight_scale_inv",
1726	            re.compile(r"\.scale$"): ".weight_scale_inv",
1727	        }
1728	    return WeightsMapper(
1729	        orig_to_new_prefix={
1730	            "layers.": "model.layers.",
1731	            "embed.": "model.embed.",
1732	            "norm.": "model.norm.",
1733	            "hc_head": "model.hc_head",
1734	            "mtp.": "model.mtp.",
1735	        },
1736	        orig_to_new_regex=scale_regex,
1737	        orig_to_new_suffix={
1738	            "head.weight": "lm_head.weight",
1739	            "embed.weight": "embed_tokens.weight",
1740	            ".ffn.gate.bias": ".ffn.gate.e_score_correction_bias",
1741	        },
1742	        orig_to_new_substr={
1743	            ".shared_experts.w2": ".shared_experts.down_proj",
1744	            "mtp.": None,
1745	        },
1746	    )

96	    """Discover, gate and instantiate `vllm.endpoint_plugins` entry points.
97	
98	    Endpoint plugins add HTTP routes to the API server, so they default to
99	    not loading. Unlike other plugin groups, a plugin here is only
100	    considered when it is explicitly named in `VLLM_PLUGINS`. This is a
101	    stricter posture than `load_plugins_by_group` which "load everything unless
102	    an allowlist says otherwise". This posture is taken to handle potentially
103	    larger exposed network surface.
104	
105	    A discovered plugin is loaded only if both hold:
106	      - it is named in `VLLM_PLUGINS` (enforced by not calling the loader
107	        at all when `VLLM_PLUGINS` is unset). Note that `VLLM_PLUGINS=""`
108	        parses to `[""]`, not `None`, so it is treated as a (non strict)
109	        allowlist that matches no plugin name, not as "unset".
110	      - its `required_tasks` is `None` or intersects `supported_tasks`.
111	
112	    Args:
113	        supported_tasks: Tasks the server supports. `None` means no plugin
114	            with a non `None` `required_tasks` will be loaded.
115	
116	    Returns:
117	        Instantiated plugins that passed gating in discovery order.
118	    """
119	    from importlib.metadata import entry_points
120	
121	    if envs.VLLM_PLUGINS is None:
122	        discovered = entry_points(group=ENDPOINT_PLUGINS_GROUP)
123	        if discovered:
124	            logger.warning(
125	                "Found endpoint plugin(s) %s but VLLM_PLUGINS is not set. "
126	                "Endpoint plugins add HTTP routes and must be explicitly "
127	                "allowlisted via VLLM_PLUGINS to be loaded.",
128	                [p.name for p in discovered],
129	            )
130	        return []
131	
132	    factories = load_plugins_by_group(ENDPOINT_PLUGINS_GROUP)
133	
134	    endpoint_plugins: list[EndpointPlugin] = []
135	    for name, factory in factories.items():
136	        try:
137	            plugin = factory()
138	        except Exception:
139	            logger.exception("Failed to instantiate endpoint plugin %s", name)
140	            continue
141	
142	        required_tasks = plugin.required_tasks
143	        if required_tasks is not None and (
144	            supported_tasks is None or not set(required_tasks) & set(supported_tasks)
145	        ):
146	            logger.info(
147	                "Skipping endpoint plugin %s: requires one of tasks %s, "
148	                "server supports %s",
149	                name,
150	                required_tasks,
151	                supported_tasks,
152	            )
153	            continue
154	
155	        logger.info("Loaded endpoint plugin %s", name)
156	        endpoint_plugins.append(plugin)
157	
158	    return endpoint_plugins

358	    """

360	    TRTLLM MXFP8; SM90 falls through to Triton_unfused or Marlin (the

386	    if backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.DEEPGEMM_MXFP4:

410	def _resolve_activation_key(
411	    model_activation_key: QuantKey | None,
412	) -> QuantKey | None:
413	    """Combine the model-supplied activation key with the user override.
414	    Raises on conflict (both set and disagreeing)."""
415	    user_override = _user_moe_activation_override()
416	    if user_override is None:
417	        return model_activation_key
418	    if model_activation_key is None or model_activation_key == user_override:
419	        return user_override
420	    raise ValueError(
421	        f"checkpoint declares MoE activation={model_activation_key} but "
422	        f"quantization_config.moe.activation={user_override}; remove the "
423	        f"override or align it with the checkpoint."

458	def _filter_by_activation(
459	    backends: list[Mxfp4MoeBackend],
460	    requested_activation_key: QuantKey | None,
461	) -> list[Mxfp4MoeBackend]:
462	    """Pick variants matching ``requested_activation_key``; without one,
463	    prefer BF16 if the list has any, else keep the list as-is so explicit
464	    non-BF16 picks (e.g. the ``_afp8`` aliases) still land."""
465	    if requested_activation_key is not None:
466	        return [
467	            b
468	            for b in backends
469	            if _backend_activation_key(b) == requested_activation_key
470	            or b == Mxfp4MoeBackend.EMULATION
471	        ]
472	    bf16 = [b for b in backends if _backend_activation_key(b) is None]
473	    return bf16 if bf16 else backends

478	    requested_activation_key: QuantKey | None,
479	) -> list[Mxfp4MoeBackend]:
480	    backends = map_mxfp4_backend(runner_backend)
481	    if runner_backend == "b12x":

483	            return [Mxfp4MoeBackend.B12X_MXFP4_BF16]
484	        # W4A8 is the high-throughput b12x path and is preferred when the
485	        # model does not request an activation format. Keep this as backend

487	        if requested_activation_key is None:

492	def _requires_qwen38_tep8_emulation(
493	    config: FusedMoEConfig,
494	    activation_key: QuantKey | None,
495	) -> bool:
496	    """Avoid the inaccurate native gfx950 kernel for Qwen3.8 TEP8.
497	
498	    Qwen3.8 Flash Next's routed experts use the distinctive
499	    ``E=512, H=2560, N=640`` W4A4 shape. With eight-way expert parallelism,
500	    AITER operates on 64 local experts and pads ``N`` to 768. That native path
501	    is not numerically reliable on gfx950, while OCP MX emulation preserves
502	    model accuracy. Keep this guard exact so other MXFP4 shapes and smaller EP
503	    configurations retain the native backend.
504	    """
505	    parallel = config.moe_parallel_config
506	    if not (
507	        activation_key == kMxfp4Dynamic
508	        and parallel.use_ep
509	        and parallel.ep_size == 8
510	        and config.num_experts == 512
511	        and config.num_local_experts == 64
512	        and config.hidden_dim == 2560
513	        and config.intermediate_size == 640
514	    ):
515	        return False
516	
517	    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
518	        return False
519	
520	    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
521	
522	    return on_gfx950()

525	def select_mxfp4_moe_backend(
526	    config: FusedMoEConfig,
527	    activation_key: QuantKey | None = None,
528	) -> tuple[Mxfp4MoeBackend, type[mk.FusedMoEExperts] | None]:
529	    """
530	    Select the primary MXFP4 MoE backend.
531	
532	    Args:
533	        config: MoE configuration
534	        activation_key: Optional activation quantization key. If provided,
535	            overrides the default activation key for backend selection.
536	            Use kFp8StaticTensorSym for W4A8 scheme.
537	
538	    Note: Shape-specific fallbacks may still occur at runtime.
539	    """
540	    runner_backend = config.moe_backend
541	    requested_activation_key = _resolve_activation_key(activation_key)
542	
543	    activation_format = (
544	        mk.FusedMoEActivationFormat.BatchedExperts
545	        if config.moe_parallel_config.use_batched_activation_format
546	        else mk.FusedMoEActivationFormat.Standard
547	    )
548	
549	    if runner_backend != "auto":
550	        requested_backends = _get_requested_backends(
551	            runner_backend, requested_activation_key
552	        )
553	        if activation_format == mk.FusedMoEActivationFormat.BatchedExperts:
554	            requested_backends = [
555	                Mxfp4MoeBackend.BATCHED_MARLIN if b == Mxfp4MoeBackend.MARLIN else b
556	                for b in requested_backends
557	            ]
558	        if not requested_backends:
559	            raise ValueError(
560	                f"moe_backend={runner_backend!r} does not support "
561	                f"activation={requested_activation_key}"
562	            )
563	        last_error: Exception | None = None
564	        for requested_backend in requested_backends:
565	            act_key = (
566	                requested_activation_key
567	                if requested_backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.EMULATION
568	                else _backend_activation_key(requested_backend)
569	            )
570	            try:
571	                return _return_or_raise(
572	                    requested_backend,
573	                    config,
574	                    kMxfp4Static,
575	                    act_key,
576	                    activation_format,
577	                )
578	            except ValueError as e:
579	                last_error = e
580	        assert last_error is not None
581	        raise last_error
582	
583	    if _requires_qwen38_tep8_emulation(config, requested_activation_key):
584	        backend = Mxfp4MoeBackend.EMULATION
585	        logger.warning_once(
586	            "Using OCP MX emulation for the Qwen3.8 Flash Next TEP8 routed "
587	            "experts on gfx950 because the native AITER W4A4 kernel is not "
588	            "numerically reliable for this shape. Performance will be lower."
589	        )
590	        return _return_or_raise(
591	            backend,
592	            config,
593	            kMxfp4Static,
594	            requested_activation_key,
595	            activation_format,
596	        )
597	
598	    # Select kernels in order of backend.
599	    AVAILABLE_BACKENDS = _filter_by_activation(
600	        _get_priority_backends_for_gpt_oss(), requested_activation_key
601	    )
602	
603	    unsupported_reasons = []
604	    for backend in AVAILABLE_BACKENDS:
605	        # Use requested_activation_key if provided, otherwise use backend default
606	        act_key = (
607	            requested_activation_key
608	            if requested_activation_key is not None
609	            else _backend_activation_key(backend)
610	        )
611	        for k_cls in backend_to_kernel_cls(backend):
612	            supported, reason = k_cls.is_supported_config(
613	                k_cls, config, kMxfp4Static, act_key, activation_format
614	            )
615	            if supported:
616	                logger.info_once(_make_log_backend(backend))
617	                return backend, k_cls
618	            else:
619	                logger.debug_once(_make_log_unsupported(backend, reason))
620	                unsupported_reasons.append((backend, reason))
621	
622	    if current_platform.is_xpu():
623	        backend = Mxfp4MoeBackend.XPU
624	        logger.info_once(_make_log_backend(backend))
625	        return _return_or_raise(
626	            Mxfp4MoeBackend.XPU,
627	            config,
628	            kMxfp4Static,
629	            None,
630	            activation_format,
631	        )
632	
633	    unsupported_log = "; ".join(
634	        [
635	            f"backend: {backend.value}, reason: {reason}"
636	            for backend, reason in unsupported_reasons
637	        ]
638	    )
639	    raise NotImplementedError(
640	        "No MXFP4 MoE backend supports the deployment configuration. "
641	        f"weight_key=kMxfp4Static, activation_key={activation_key}. "
642	        f"Candidate backends were: "
643	        f"{[backend.value for backend in AVAILABLE_BACKENDS]}. "
644	        f"Unsupported reasons: {unsupported_log}. "
645	    )
646

648	def select_deepseek_v4_mxfp4_moe_backend(
649	    config: FusedMoEConfig,
650	) -> tuple[Mxfp4MoeBackend, type[mk.FusedMoEExperts] | None]:
651	    """
652	    Select the MXFP4 MoE backend with MXFP8 activation as top priority.
653	    Falls back through BF16 and other backends.
654	    """
655	    activation_format = (
656	        mk.FusedMoEActivationFormat.BatchedExperts
657	        if config.moe_parallel_config.use_batched_activation_format
658	        else mk.FusedMoEActivationFormat.Standard
659	    )
660	
661	    # Honor explicit moe_backend (e.g. "marlin", "triton_unfused") before
662	    # falling back to the auto priority list.
663	    runner_backend = config.moe_backend
664	    if runner_backend != "auto":
665	        if runner_backend == "b12x":
666	            requested_backends = _get_requested_backends(runner_backend, None)
667	        else:
668	            # Try every variant of the alias in priority order. Narrowing to
669	            # the BF16 variant would drop SM100+ W4A8 variants on devices where
670	            # the BF16 variant is gated to SM90.
671	            requested_backends = map_mxfp4_backend(runner_backend)
672	        if activation_format == mk.FusedMoEActivationFormat.BatchedExperts:
673	            requested_backends = [
674	                Mxfp4MoeBackend.BATCHED_MARLIN if b == Mxfp4MoeBackend.MARLIN else b
675	                for b in requested_backends
676	            ]
677	        last_error: Exception | None = None
678	        for requested_backend in requested_backends:
679	            try:
680	                return _return_or_raise(
681	                    requested_backend,
682	                    config,
683	                    kMxfp4Static,
684	                    _backend_activation_key(requested_backend),
685	                    activation_format,
686	                )
687	            except ValueError as e:
688	                last_error = e
689	        assert last_error is not None
690	        raise last_error
691	
692	    # DeepSeek-V4 on ROCm: prefer AITER FlyDSL MoE (better perf + accuracy
693	    # after shuffle/TP-offset fixes), with Triton-unfused as fallback.
694	    if (
695	        current_platform.is_rocm()
696	        and config.routing_method == RoutingMethodType.DeepseekV4
697	    ):
698	        priority_backends = [
699	            Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16,
700	            Mxfp4MoeBackend.TRITON_UNFUSED,
701	        ]
702	    else:
703	        priority_backends = _get_priority_backends()
704	
705	    # Iterate priority backends: TRTLLM MXFP8, then Triton.
706	    for backend in priority_backends:
707	        activation_key = _backend_activation_key(backend)
708	        for k_cls in backend_to_kernel_cls(backend):
709	            supported, reason = k_cls.is_supported_config(
710	                k_cls, config, kMxfp4Static, activation_key, activation_format
711	            )
712	            if supported:
713	                logger.info_once(_make_log_backend(backend), scope="local")
714	                return backend, k_cls
715	            else:
716	                logger.debug_once(_make_log_unsupported(backend, reason), scope="local")
717	
718	    raise NotImplementedError(
719	        "No MXFP4 MoE backend supports the deployment configuration."
720	    )

723	def mxfp4_round_up_hidden_size_and_intermediate_size(
724	    backend: Mxfp4MoeBackend,
725	    hidden_size: int,
726	    intermediate_size: int,
727	    activation: MoEActivation | None = None,
728	) -> tuple[int, int]:
729	    """Round up hidden_size and intermediate_size based on backend requirements."""
730	    if backend in B12X_BACKENDS:
731	        # b12x plans for the exact model dimensions. B12xExperts validates the
732	        # required MXFP4 block alignment before selecting the backend.
733	        return hidden_size, intermediate_size
734	    if backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.EMULATION:
735	        # Emulation has no kernel tile; it only needs OCP MX block alignment so the
736	        # per-block scale buffers (`dim // OCP_MX_BLOCK_SIZE`) aren't floor-truncated
737	        # by a non-block-aligned TP/DP shard (e.g. 2880 // 4 = 720).
738	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, OCP_MX_BLOCK_SIZE)
739	        hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, OCP_MX_BLOCK_SIZE)
740	    elif backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.DEEPGEMM_MXFP4:
741	        # DeepGEMM requires M/N/K alignment
742	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 128)
743	        hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 128)
744	    elif backend in (Mxfp4MoeBackend.MARLIN, Mxfp4MoeBackend.BATCHED_MARLIN):
745	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 128)
746	        if current_platform.is_xpu():
747	            hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 128)
748	        else:
749	            hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 256)
750	    elif backend in TRTLLM_BACKENDS:
751	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 128)
752	        hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 256)
753	    elif backend in (
754	        Mxfp4MoeBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTLASS_MXFP4_BF16,
755	        Mxfp4MoeBackend.FLASHINFER_CUTLASS_MXFP4_MXFP8,
756	    ):
757	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 128)
758	        hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 128)
759	    elif current_platform.is_rocm():
760	        if backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16 and (
761	            activation == MoEActivation.SITU or activation == MoEActivation.SILU
762	        ):
763	            # K3's AITER A16W4 SiTU kernel handles K3's native intermediate size
764	            # (moe_intermediate 3072; e.g. 384/partition at TP8). Align to 128 (a
765	            # no-op for K3's shapes) rather than the generic ROCm 256 round-up,
766	            # which would inflate weights and OOM.
767	            intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 128)
768	            hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 128)
769	        else:
770	            intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 256)
771	            hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 256)
772	    elif backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.CPU:
773	        # CPU AMX kernel uses BLOCK_N=32, align to 32
774	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 32)
775	        hidden_size = round_up(hidden_size, 32)
776	    else:
777	        intermediate_size = round_up(intermediate_size, 64)
778	    return hidden_size, intermediate_size

786	    w13_weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
787	    w2_weight_scale: torch.Tensor,

789	    w2_bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,

797	    Union[torch.Tensor, "PrecisionConfig"],
798	    torch.Tensor | None,
799	    torch.Tensor | None,
800	]:
801	    """Convert loaded weights into backend-specific kernel format."""
802	
803	    if mxfp4_backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.DEEPGEMM_MXFP4:
804	        w13_weight_scale, w2_weight_scale = _pack_deepgemm_mxfp4_scales(

813	            w2_weight.data,
814	            w13_weight_scale,
815	            w2_weight_scale,
816	            w13_bias,
817	            w2_bias,
818	        )
819	
820	    num_experts = w13_weight.shape[0]
821	    intermediate_size = w13_weight.shape[1] // 2
822	    hidden_size = w13_weight.shape[2] * 2
823	
824	    sf_block_size = 32  # mxfp4 block size
825	
826	    if mxfp4_backend == Mxfp4MoeBackend.HUMMING:
827	        from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming_utils import (
828	            convert_to_humming_moe_kernel_format,
829	        )

420	    def compute_hash(self) -> str:
421	        """
422	        WARNING: Whenever a new field is added to this config,
423	        ensure that it is included in the factors list if
424	        it affects the computation graph.

427	        that affect the structure of the computation
428	        graph from input ids/embeddings to the final hidden states,
429	        excluding anything before input ids/embeddings and after
430	        the final hidden states.
431	        """
432	        ignored_factors = {
433	            "convert",
434	            "tokenizer",
435	            "tokenizer_mode",
436	            "seed",
437	            "hf_config_path",
438	            "allowed_local_media_path",
439	            "allowed_media_domains",
440	            "tokenizer_revision",
441	            "spec_target_max_model_len",
442	            "enforce_eager",
443	            "return_sampling_mask",
444	            "logprobs_mode",
445	            "use_fp64_gumbel",
446	            "enable_trace_replay",
447	            "disable_cascade_attn",
448	            "skip_tokenizer_init",
449	            "served_model_name",
450	            "config_format",
451	            "hf_token",
452	            "hf_overrides",
453	            "logits_processors",
454	            "io_processor_plugin",
455	            "pooler_config",
456	            "multimodal_config",
457	            "limit_mm_per_prompt",
458	            "media_io_kwargs",
459	            "mm_processor_kwargs",
460	            "mm_processor_cache_gb",
461	            "mm_processor_cache_type",
462	            "mm_shm_cache_max_object_size_mb",
463	            "mm_encoder_tp_mode",
464	            "interleave_mm_strings",
465	            "skip_mm_profiling",
466	            "mm_ipc_gpu_memory_gb",
467	        }
468	
469	        from vllm.config.utils import get_hash_factors, hash_factors
470	
471	        factors = get_hash_factors(self, ignored_factors)

480	    def _update_nested(
481	        self,
482	        target: PretrainedConfig | dict[str, Any],
483	        updates: dict[str, Any],
484	    ) -> None:
485	        """Recursively updates a config or dict with nested updates."""
486	        for key, value in updates.items():
487	            if isinstance(value, dict):
488	                # Get the nested target
489	                if isinstance(target, dict):
490	                    nested_target = target.get(key)
491	                else:
492	                    nested_target = getattr(target, key, None)
493	
494	                # If nested target exists and can be updated recursively
495	                if nested_target is not None and (
496	                    isinstance(nested_target, dict)
497	                    or hasattr(nested_target, "__dict__")
498	                ):
499	                    self._update_nested(nested_target, value)
500	                    continue
501	
502	            # Set the value (base case)
503	            if isinstance(target, dict):
504	                target[key] = value
505	            else:
506	                setattr(target, key, value)

508	    def _apply_dict_overrides(
509	        self,
510	        config: PretrainedConfig,
511	        overrides: dict[str, Any],
512	    ) -> None:
513	        """Apply dict overrides, handling both nested configs and dict values."""
514	        from transformers import PretrainedConfig
515	
516	        for key, value in overrides.items():
517	            attr = getattr(config, key, None)
518	            if attr is not None and isinstance(attr, PretrainedConfig):
519	                # It's a nested config - recursively update it
520	                self._update_nested(attr, value)
521	            else:
522	                # It's a dict-valued parameter - set it directly
523	                setattr(config, key, value)

871	    def _supports_multimodal_for_mm_prefix(self) -> bool:
872	        """Whether multimodal inputs can still appear for this deployment.
873	
874	        This runs more than once per config: once early in ``__post_init__``
875	        (before ``multimodal_config`` exists), again after it is created, and
876	        then for every ``get_model_arch_config`` regeneration -- notably
877	        ``with_hf_config``, which deep-copies this ``ModelConfig`` and swaps
878	        ``hf_config`` for a text-only submodule (e.g. ``Gemma4ForCausalLM``).
879	
880	        The result is cached for correctness, not just to save work: on the
881	        ``with_hf_config`` copy the submodule architecture has no registered
882	        multimodal processor, so re-querying the registry would raise and be
883	        treated as text-only, wrongly clearing ``is_mm_prefix_lm`` even when a
884	        vision modality is still enabled (e.g. ``image=0`` but video allowed).
885	        The deep-copied cache preserves the top-level decision instead.
886	        """
887	        cached = getattr(self, "_supports_multimodal_inputs_cached", None)
888	        if cached is not None:
889	            return cached
890	
891	        if self.multimodal_config is None:
892	            # Early call before multimodal init — do not clear mm_prefix yet.
893	            return True
894	
895	        from vllm.multimodal import MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY
896	
897	        supports_mm = MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.supports_multimodal_inputs(self)
898	        self._supports_multimodal_inputs_cached = supports_mm
899	        if not supports_mm:
900	            logger.info_once(
901	                "Disabled mm_prefix attention mode because multimodal inputs "
902	                "are configuration-disabled. Attention backends without "
903	                "mm_prefix support may now be selected."
904	            )
905	        return supports_mm

1009	        `model_impl` is set to `transformers` or `auto`."""
1010	        cls = "Transformers"

1045	    def _maybe_register_model_class_overrides(self) -> None:
1046	        # Apply ``model_class_overrides`` here because this property is the
1047	        # single chokepoint through which every model-class inspect/resolve
1048	        # passes, in both the engine front-end and every worker process. The
1049	        # guard is process-local (see ``_REGISTERED_MODEL_CLASS_OVERRIDES``), so
1050	        # each worker re-registers into its own ModelRegistry exactly once
1051	        # rather than trusting a pickled-in instance flag.
1052	        if not self.model_class_overrides:
1053	            return
1054	        pending = [
1055	            (arch, target)
1056	            for arch, target in self.model_class_overrides.items()
1057	            if (arch, target) not in _REGISTERED_MODEL_CLASS_OVERRIDES
1058	        ]
1059	        if not pending:
1060	            return
1061	        logger.warning_once(
1062	            "Applying model_class_overrides %s. This is intended for "
1063	            "development/debugging.",
1064	            str(self.model_class_overrides),
1065	        )
1066	        for arch, target in pending:
1067	            me_models.ModelRegistry.register_model(arch, target)
1068	            _REGISTERED_MODEL_CLASS_OVERRIDES.add((arch, target))

1130	    def maybe_untie_word_embeddings(self) -> None:
1131	        """Stop trusting `tie_word_embeddings` when the checkpoint disagrees.
1132	
1133	        A config may claim the word embeddings are tied while the checkpoint
1134	        ships an `lm_head` of its own. Tying regardless would silently discard
1135	        that tensor, so build the `lm_head` as if untied and let it load. The
1136	        two are compared once loaded, and re-tied if they turn out to match, by
1137	        [maybe_retie_word_embeddings][vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_tying.maybe_retie_word_embeddings].
1138	
1139	        Transformers makes the same decision in `PreTrainedModel.tie_weights`,
1140	        where it can compare the two tensors directly.
1141	        """
1142	        if not getattr(self.hf_config, "tie_word_embeddings", False):
1143	            return
1144	        if not checkpoint_has_lm_head(self.model, revision=self.revision):
1145	            return
1146	
1147	        logger.debug(
1148	            "The config for %s says the word embeddings are tied, but the checkpoint "
1149	            "contains an lm_head. Loading it to find out whether they really are tied.",
1150	            self.model,
1151	        )
1152	        # Both levels must be updated: `VllmConfig.with_hf_config` reads the top
1153	        # level, and the text config is what the language model itself sees.
1154	        self.hf_config.tie_word_embeddings = False
1155	        self.hf_config.get_text_config().tie_word_embeddings = False
1156	        self.word_embeddings_untied_by_checkpoint = True

1264	        quant_cfg = self.model_arch_config.quantization_config

1266	        if quant_cfg is not None:
1267	            quant_method = quant_cfg["quant_method"]
1268	            # Quantization methods which are overrides (i.e. they have a
1269	            # `override_quantization_method` method) must be checked in order
1270	            # of preference (this is particularly important for GPTQ).
1271	            overrides = [
1272	                "auto_gptq",
1273	                "gptq",
1274	                "gptq_marlin",
1275	                "auto_awq",
1276	                "awq",
1277	                "awq_marlin",
1278	                "inc",
1279	                "moe_wna16",
1280	                "modelopt",
1281	                "modelopt_fp4",
1282	                "modelopt_mxfp8",
1283	                "mxfp8",
1284	                "modelopt_mixed",
1285	                # Ensure heavy backends are probed last to avoid unnecessary
1286	                # imports during override detection (e.g., MXFP4 imports Triton)
1287	                "mxfp4",
1288	                "gpt_oss_mxfp4",
1289	                "deepseek_v4_fp8",
1290	                "humming",
1291	            ]
1292	            # if the user specifies humming, we should always use humming
1293	            if self.quantization == "humming":
1294	                overrides = ["humming"] + overrides
1295	            quantization_methods = [
1296	                q for q in supported_quantization if q not in overrides
1297	            ]
1298	            # Any custom overrides will be in quantization_methods so we place
1299	            # them at the start of the list so custom overrides have preference
1300	            # over the built-in ones.
1301	            quantization_methods = quantization_methods + overrides
1302	
1303	            # Detect which checkpoint is it
1304	            for name in quantization_methods:
1305	                method = me_quant.get_quantization_config(name)
1306	                quantization_override = method.override_quantization_method(
1307	                    quant_cfg, self.quantization, hf_config=self.hf_config
1308	                )
1309	                if quantization_override is not None:
1310	                    # Raise error if the override is not custom (custom would
1311	                    # be in QUANTIZATION_METHODS but not QuantizationMethods)
1312	                    # and hasn't been added to the overrides list.
1313	                    if (
1314	                        name in get_args(me_quant.QuantizationMethods)
1315	                        and name not in overrides
1316	                    ):
1317	                        raise ValueError(
1318	                            f"Quantization method {name} is an override but "
1319	                            "is has not been added to the `overrides` list "
1320	                            "above. This is necessary to ensure that the "
1321	                            "overrides are checked in order of preference."
1322	                        )
1323	                    quant_method = quantization_override
1324	                    self.quantization = quantization_override
1325	                    break
1326	
1327	            quant_method = quant_method if quant_method != "" else None
1328	            # Verify quantization configurations.
1329	            if self.quantization is None:
1330	                self.quantization = quant_method
1331	            elif self.quantization != quant_method:
1332	                raise ValueError(
1333	                    "Quantization method specified in the model config "
1334	                    f"({quant_method}) does not match the quantization "
1335	                    f"method specified in the `quantization` argument "
1336	                    f"({self.quantization})."
1337	                )
1338	
1339	        if self.quantization is not None:
1340	            if self.quantization not in supported_quantization:
1341	                raise ValueError(
1342	                    f"Unknown quantization method: {self.quantization}. Must "
1343	                    f"be one of {supported_quantization}."
1344	                )
1345	            current_platform.verify_quantization(self.quantization)
1346	
1347	        if self.quantization in me_quant.DEPRECATED_QUANTIZATION_METHODS:
1348	            if self.allow_deprecated_quantization:
1349	                logger.warning(
1350	                    "The quantization method %s is deprecated "
1351	                    "and will be removed in future versions of vLLM.",
1352	                    self.quantization,
1353	                )
1354	            else:
1355	                raise ValueError(
1356	                    "The quantization method %s is deprecated "
1357	                    "and will be removed in future versions of vLLM. To bypass, "
1358	                    "set `--allow-deprecated-quantization`.",
1359	                    self.quantization,
1360	                )

1420	    def verify_with_parallel_config(
1421	        self,
1422	        parallel_config: ParallelConfig,
1423	    ) -> None:
1424	        total_num_attention_heads = self.model_arch_config.total_num_attention_heads
1425	        tensor_parallel_size = parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
1426	        if total_num_attention_heads % tensor_parallel_size != 0:
1427	            raise ValueError(
1428	                f"Total number of attention heads ({total_num_attention_heads})"
1429	                " must be divisible by tensor parallel size "
1430	                f"({tensor_parallel_size})."
1431	            )
1432	
1433	        if parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel:
1434	            self._verify_with_expert_parallelism()
1435	
1436	        pipeline_parallel_size = parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size
1437	        if pipeline_parallel_size > 1 and not self.registry.is_pp_supported_model(
1438	            self.architectures, self
1439	        ):
1440	            raise NotImplementedError(
1441	                "Pipeline parallelism is not supported for this model. "
1442	                "Supported models implement the `SupportsPP` interface."
1443	            )
1444	
1445	        decode_context_parallel_size = parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
1446	        if decode_context_parallel_size > 1 and not self.use_mla:
1447	            total_num_kv_heads = self.get_total_num_kv_heads()
1448	            if tensor_parallel_size <= total_num_kv_heads:
1449	                raise ValueError(
1450	                    "Decode context parallelism for GQA/MQA requires "
1451	                    f"`--tensor-parallel-size` ({tensor_parallel_size}) to be "
1452	                    "greater than the model's total number of KV heads "
1453	                    f"({total_num_kv_heads}). Increase `--tensor-parallel-size` "
1454	                    "or set `--decode-context-parallel-size 1`."
1455	                )
1456	
1457	            max_dcp_size = tensor_parallel_size // total_num_kv_heads
1458	            if decode_context_parallel_size > max_dcp_size:
1459	                raise ValueError(
1460	                    "`--decode-context-parallel-size` "
1461	                    f"({decode_context_parallel_size}) exceeds the maximum "
1462	                    f"supported value ({max_dcp_size}) for "
1463	                    f"`--tensor-parallel-size` ({tensor_parallel_size}) and "
1464	                    f"{total_num_kv_heads} model KV heads."
1465	                )
1466	
1467	            num_q_per_kv = total_num_attention_heads // total_num_kv_heads
1468	            if num_q_per_kv % decode_context_parallel_size != 0:
1469	                raise ValueError(
1470	                    "The model's number of query heads per KV head "
1471	                    f"({num_q_per_kv}) must be divisible by "
1472	                    "`--decode-context-parallel-size` "
1473	                    f"({decode_context_parallel_size}) for GQA/MQA."
1474	                )
1475	
1476	        # torch_shm uses a single IPC queue to rank 0; DP>1 is
1477	        # incompatible because API servers can't know which
1478	        # CoreEngine the scheduler will assign work to. TP>1 is
1479	        # also not supported because this requires broadcasting
1480	        # MM tensors between all TP ranks.
1481	        if (
1482	            self.multimodal_config is not None
1483	            and self.multimodal_config.mm_tensor_ipc == "torch_shm"
1484	            and parallel_config.world_size_across_dp > 1
1485	        ):
1486	            raise ValueError(
1487	                "mm_tensor_ipc='torch_shm' is not supported with "
1488	                "data_parallel_size > 1 or tensor_parallel_size > 1 "
1489	                "or pipeline_parallel_size > 1."
1490	            )

1530	    def get_num_kv_heads(
1531	        self,
1532	        parallel_config: ParallelConfig,
1533	        arch_config: ModelArchitectureConfig | None = None,
1534	    ) -> int:
1535	        """Returns the number of KV heads per GPU.
1536	
1537	        Pass ``arch_config`` (from ``model_arch_config[layer_idx]``) to size a
1538	        single layer of a heterogeneous model rather than the model as a whole.
1539	        """
1540	        if self.use_mla:
1541	            # When using MLA during decode it becomes MQA
1542	            return 1
1543	
1544	        arch_config = arch_config or self.model_arch_config
1545	        total_num_kv_heads = arch_config.total_num_kv_heads
1546	        # If tensor parallelism is used, we divide the number of KV heads by
1547	        # the tensor parallel size. We will replicate the KV heads in the
1548	        # case where the number of KV heads is smaller than the tensor
1549	        # parallel size so each GPU has at least one KV head.
1550	        return max(1, total_num_kv_heads // parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size)

1594	    def get_num_layers_by_block_type(
1595	        self,
1596	        parallel_config: ParallelConfig,
1597	        block_type: LayerBlockType = "attention",
1598	    ) -> int:
1599	        # This function relies on 'layers_block_type' in hf_config,
1600	        # for w/o this attribute, we will need to have workarounds like so
1601	        attn_block_type = block_type == "attention"
1602	        is_transformer = (
1603	            not self.is_hybrid and not self.has_noops and not self.is_attention_free
1604	        )
1605	        start, end = self.get_layers_start_end_indices(parallel_config)
1606	
1607	        if is_transformer:
1608	            # Handle the basic case first
1609	            return end - start if attn_block_type else 0
1610	        elif self.is_attention_free:
1611	            # Attention free
1612	            # Note that this code assumes there
1613	            # is only one type of attention-free block type.
1614	            return 0 if attn_block_type else end - start
1615	        elif self.has_noops:
1616	            block_configs = self.hf_config.block_configs
1617	            return sum(not bc.attention.no_op for bc in block_configs[start:end])
1618	        else:
1619	            # Hybrid model Jamba
1620	            layers_block_type_value = getattr(
1621	                self.hf_text_config, "layers_block_type", None
1622	            )
1623	            if layers_block_type_value is not None:
1624	                if self.model_arch_config.text_model_type == "zamba2":
1625	                    if attn_block_type:
1626	                        return sum(
1627	                            t == "hybrid" for t in layers_block_type_value[start:end]
1628	                        )
1629	                    else:
1630	                        return self.get_num_layers(parallel_config)
1631	                return sum(t == block_type for t in layers_block_type_value[start:end])
1632	
1633	            # Hybrid model Minimax
1634	            attn_type_list = getattr(self.hf_config, "attn_type_list", None)
1635	            if attn_type_list:
1636	                return sum(t == 1 for t in attn_type_list[start:end])
1637	
1638	            # Hybrid model Qwen3Next Qwen3.5 Series
1639	            layer_types_value = getattr(self.hf_text_config, "layer_types", None)
1640	            if layer_types_value is not None:
1641	                if block_type == "attention":
1642	                    return sum(
1643	                        t == "full_attention" for t in layer_types_value[start:end]
1644	                    )
1645	                elif block_type == "linear_attention":
1646	                    return sum(
1647	                        t == "linear_attention" for t in layer_types_value[start:end]
1648	                    )
1649	                else:
1650	                    return sum(t == block_type for t in layer_types_value[start:end])
1651	
1652	            if (
1653	                layers_block_type_value is None
1654	                and attn_type_list is None
1655	                and layer_types_value is None
1656	            ):
1657	                raise ValueError(
1658	                    "The model is an hybrid without a layers_block_type or an "
1659	                    "attn_type_list, or a layer_types in the hf_config, "
1660	                    f"cannot determine the num of {block_type} layers"
1661	                )
1662	            raise AssertionError(f"Unsupported block type: {block_type}")

1693	    def try_get_generation_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
1694	        """
1695	        This method attempts to retrieve the non-default values of the
1696	        generation config for this model.
1697	
1698	        The generation config can contain information about special tokens, as
1699	        well as sampling parameters. Which is why this method exists separately
1700	        to `get_diff_sampling_param`.
1701	
1702	        Returns:
1703	            A dictionary containing the non-default generation config.
1704	        """
1705	        if self.generation_config in {"auto", "vllm"}:
1706	            config = try_get_generation_config(
1707	                self.hf_config_path or self.model,
1708	                trust_remote_code=self.trust_remote_code,
1709	                revision=self.revision,
1710	                code_revision=self.code_revision,
1711	                config_format=self.config_format,
1712	                hf_token=self.hf_token,
1713	            )
1714	        else:
1715	            config = try_get_generation_config(
1716	                self.generation_config,
1717	                trust_remote_code=self.trust_remote_code,
1718	                code_revision=self.code_revision,
1719	                config_format=self.config_format,
1720	                hf_token=self.hf_token,
1721	            )
1722	
1723	        if config is None:
1724	            return {}
1725

1728	    def get_diff_sampling_param(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
1729	        """
1730	        This method returns a dictionary containing the non-default sampling
1731	        parameters with `override_generation_config` applied.
1732	
1733	        The default sampling parameters are:
1734	
1735	        - vLLM's neutral defaults if `self.generation_config="vllm"`
1736	        - the model's defaults if `self.generation_config="auto"`
1737	        - as defined in `generation_config.json` if
1738	            `self.generation_config="path/to/generation_config/dir"`
1739	
1740	        Returns:
1741	            A dictionary containing the non-default sampling parameters.
1742	        """
1743	        src = self.generation_config
1744	
1745	        config = {} if src == "vllm" else self.try_get_generation_config()
1746	
1747	        # Overriding with given generation config
1748	        config.update(self.override_generation_config)
1749	
1750	        available_params = [
1751	            "repetition_penalty",
1752	            "temperature",
1753	            "top_k",
1754	            "top_p",
1755	            "min_p",
1756	            "max_new_tokens",
1757	        ]
1758	        if any(p in config for p in available_params):
1759	            diff_sampling_param = {
1760	                p: config.get(p) for p in available_params if config.get(p) is not None
1761	            }
1762	            # Huggingface definition of max_new_tokens is equivalent
1763	            # to vLLM's max_tokens
1764	            if "max_new_tokens" in diff_sampling_param:
1765	                diff_sampling_param["max_tokens"] = diff_sampling_param.pop(
1766	                    "max_new_tokens"
1767	                )
1768	        else:
1769	            diff_sampling_param = {}
1770	
1771	        if diff_sampling_param and src != "vllm":
1772	            logger.warning_once(
1773	                "Default vLLM sampling parameters have been overridden by %s: `%s`. "
1774	                "If this is not intended, please relaunch vLLM instance "
1775	                "with `--generation-config vllm`.",
1776	                "the model's `generation_config.json`" if src == "auto" else src,
1777	                str(diff_sampling_param),
1778	                scope="local",
1779	            )
1780	
1781	        return diff_sampling_param

1783	    def get_pooling_task(
1784	        self, supported_tasks: tuple[SupportedTask, ...]
1785	    ) -> PoolingTask | None:
1786	        if self.pooler_config is None:
1787	            return None
1788	
1789	        pooling_task = self.pooler_config.task
1790	
1791	        if pooling_task is not None:
1792	            if self.pooler_config.task in supported_tasks:
1793	                return self.pooler_config.task
1794	            else:
1795	                raise RuntimeError(
1796	                    f"Unsupported task: {pooling_task!r} "
1797	                    f"Supported tasks: {supported_tasks}"
1798	                )
1799	
1800	        if "token_classify" in supported_tasks:
1801	            for architecture in self.architectures:
1802	                if "ForTokenClassification" in architecture:
1803	                    return "token_classify"
1804	
1805	        priority: list[PoolingTask] = [
1806	            "embed&token_classify",
1807	            "embed",
1808	            "classify",
1809	            "token_embed",
1810	            "token_classify",
1811	            "plugin",
1812	        ]
1813	        for task in priority:
1814	            if task in supported_tasks:
1815	                return task
1816	        return None

291	    def _to_scalar(loaded_weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
292	        # Per-tensor scales arrive 0-D or as shape-(1,) (llm-compressor NVFP4);

296	    def _load_per_tensor_weight_scale(
297	        self,
298	        shard_id: str,
299	        param: torch.nn.Parameter,
300	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
301	        expert_id: int,
302	    ):
303	        param_data = param.data
304	        # for per tensor weight quantization
305	        if shard_id in ("w1", "w3"):
306	            # We have to keep the weight scales of w1 and w3 because
307	            # we need to re-quantize w1/w3 weights after weight loading.
308	            idx = 0 if shard_id == "w1" else 1
309	            param_data[expert_id][idx] = self._to_scalar(loaded_weight)

312	            param_data[expert_id] = self._to_scalar(loaded_weight)

392	    @staticmethod
393	    def _get_hidden_dim(shard_dim: int, ndim: int) -> int:
394	        """Compute the hidden dimension index from the shard (intermediate)
395	        dimension and tensor rank.
396	
397	        For 2D weight tensors the two data dims are (0, 1). For 3D tensors
398	        with an expert dimension at dim 0, they are (1, 2). ``shard_dim``
399	        occupies one of these; the hidden dimension is the other.
400	        For 1D tensors (e.g. per-channel scales) returns 0.
401	        """
402	        if ndim < 2:
403	            return 0
404	        dim_a = ndim - 2
405	        dim_b = ndim - 1
406	        if shard_dim == dim_a:
407	            return dim_b
408	        if shard_dim == dim_b:
409	            return dim_a
410	        raise ValueError(
411	            f"shard_dim={shard_dim} is not a valid data dimension "
412	            f"for a {ndim}D tensor (expected {dim_a} or {dim_b})"
413	        )
414	
415	    @staticmethod
416	    def _orient_fused_weight(
417	        fused_weight: torch.Tensor,
418	        is_fused_checkpoint_transposed: bool,
419	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
420	        """Normalise a fused expert tensor to the vLLM weight layout."""
421	        if is_fused_checkpoint_transposed:
422	            return fused_weight.transpose(-1, -2)
423	        return fused_weight
424	
425	    @staticmethod
426	    def _narrow_expert_data_for_padding(
427	        expert_data: torch.Tensor,
428	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
429	        hidden_dim: int,
430	        shard_dim: int | None = None,
431	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
432	        """Narrow expert_data to match loaded_weight for padded dimensions.
433	
434	        When backends (e.g., DeepEP) round up hidden_size, weight parameters
435	        are larger than checkpoint weights. Narrow the padded hidden dimension
436	        before copying. Similarly, when padding occurs on the shard
437	        (intermediate) dimension (e.g. for MXFP4 GEMM), narrow that dimension
438	        as well.
439	
440	        Args:
441	            expert_data: The (possibly padded) parameter tensor to narrow.
442	            loaded_weight: The checkpoint weight tensor with original size.
443	            hidden_dim: The dimension index corresponding to hidden_size.
444	                Must be non-negative.
445	            shard_dim: The dimension index corresponding to the shard
446	                (intermediate) dimension. Defaults to `None`.
447	        """
448	        dims = (hidden_dim,) if shard_dim is None else (hidden_dim, shard_dim)
449	        if loaded_weight.ndim > 0:
450	            for dim in dims:
451	                if (
452	                    0 <= dim < expert_data.ndim
453	                    and dim < loaded_weight.ndim
454	                    and expert_data.shape[dim] > loaded_weight.shape[dim]
455	                ):
456	                    expert_data = expert_data.narrow(dim, 0, loaded_weight.shape[dim])
457	        return expert_data
458	
459	    def _load_w13(
460	        self,
461	        expert_data: torch.Tensor,
462	        shard_dim: int,
463	        shard_id: str,
464	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
465	        tp_rank: int,
466	        load_full: bool = False,
467	    ):
468	        # Index the loaded weight for tp sharding.
469	        # gate_up_proj: "MergedColumnParallel", so tp sharding on output_dim
470	        if self.moe_config.is_act_and_mul:
471	            shard_size = expert_data.shape[shard_dim] // 2
472	        else:
473	            shard_size = expert_data.shape[shard_dim]
474	        # Only narrow if the loaded_weight is not a scalar (0-dim tensor)
475	        # and we're not loading the full weight
476	        if not load_full and loaded_weight.ndim > 0:
477	            # When the parameter has been padded (e.g. MXFP4 rounding up
478	            # intermediate_size_per_partition), shard_size is the padded
479	            # size.  Compute the offset into the checkpoint weight using
480	            # the *unpadded* per-rank size so that every TP rank lands at
481	            # the correct slice.
482	            tp_size = self.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size
483	            loaded_per_rank = loaded_weight.shape[shard_dim] // tp_size
484	            start_offset = loaded_per_rank * tp_rank
485	            available = loaded_weight.shape[shard_dim] - start_offset
486	            if available <= 0:
487	                # If there is no available weight to load for this TP rank
488	                # (can happen on last TP rank with padding), we can skip
489	                # loading and return early
490	                return
491	            narrow_size = min(loaded_per_rank, available)
492	            loaded_weight = loaded_weight.narrow(shard_dim, start_offset, narrow_size)
493	        # Narrow parameter and load.
494	        # w1, gate_proj: Load into first logical weight of w13.
495	        if shard_id == "w1":
496	            expert_data = expert_data.narrow(shard_dim, 0, shard_size)
497	        # w3, up_proj: Load into second logical weight of w13.
498	        else:
499	            assert shard_id == "w3"
500	            expert_data = expert_data.narrow(shard_dim, shard_size, shard_size)
501	        hidden_dim = self._get_hidden_dim(shard_dim, expert_data.ndim)
502	        expert_data = self._narrow_expert_data_for_padding(
503	            expert_data,
504	            loaded_weight,
505	            hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
506	            shard_dim=shard_dim,
507	        )
508	        expert_data.copy_(loaded_weight)
509	
510	    def _load_w2(
511	        self,
512	        expert_data: torch.Tensor,
513	        shard_dim: int,
514	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
515	        tp_rank: int,
516	    ):
517	        # Index the loaded weight for tp sharding.
518	        # down_proj: "RowParallel" so tp sharding on input_dim
519	        # Only narrow if the loaded_weight is not a scalar (0-dim tensor).
520	        if loaded_weight.ndim > 0:
521	            # Same padding fix as _load_w13: use unpadded per-rank size.
522	            tp_size = self.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size
523	            loaded_per_rank = loaded_weight.shape[shard_dim] // tp_size
524	            start_offset = loaded_per_rank * tp_rank
525	            available = loaded_weight.shape[shard_dim] - start_offset
526	            if available <= 0:
527	                # If there is no available weight to load for this TP rank
528	                # (can happen on last TP rank with padding), we can skip
529	                # loading and return early
530	                return
531	            narrow_size = min(loaded_per_rank, available)
532	            loaded_weight = loaded_weight.narrow(shard_dim, start_offset, narrow_size)
533	        # w2, down_proj: Load into only logical weight of w2.
534	        hidden_dim = self._get_hidden_dim(shard_dim, expert_data.ndim)
535	        expert_data = self._narrow_expert_data_for_padding(
536	            expert_data,
537	            loaded_weight,
538	            hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
539	            shard_dim=shard_dim,
540	        )
541	        expert_data.copy_(loaded_weight)
542	
543	    def _load_single_value(
544	        self, param: torch.nn.Parameter, loaded_weight: torch.Tensor, expert_id: int
545	    ):

549	        # param (compressed-tensors). Assign directly so both shapes load;
550	        # _to_scalar's reshape(()) would reject the size-2 weight_shape.
551	        param_data[expert_id] = loaded_weight

565	    def weight_loader(
566	        self,
567	        param: torch.nn.Parameter,
568	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,

575	    def weight_loader(
576	        self,
577	        param: torch.nn.Parameter,
578	        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
579	        weight_name: str,
580	        shard_id: str,
581	        expert_id: int,
582	        return_success: bool = False,
583	    ) -> bool | None:
584	        quant_config_name = self.quant_config and self.quant_config.get_name()
585	        if quant_config_name == "gpt_oss_mxfp4":
586	            # (FIXME) for gpt-oss all experts are combined
587	            if "bias" in weight_name:
588	                dim1 = loaded_weight.shape[1]
589	                param.data[:, :dim1].copy_(loaded_weight)
590	            else:
591	                dim1 = loaded_weight.shape[1]
592	                dim2 = loaded_weight.shape[2]
593	                param.data[:, :dim1, :dim2].copy_(loaded_weight)
594	            return True if return_success else None
595	
596	        quant_method_name = self.quant_method.__class__.__name__
597	        global_expert_id = expert_id
598	        expert_id = self._map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id(global_expert_id)
599	
600	        use_global_sf = (
601	            getattr(self.quant_method, "use_global_sf", False)
602	            and "input_scale" in weight_name
603	        )
604	
605	        if expert_id == -1 and not use_global_sf:
606	            # Failed to load this param since it's not local to this rank
607	            return False if return_success else None
608	        # Hereafter, `expert_id` is local physical id
609	
610	        # is_transposed: if the dim to shard the weight
611	        # should be flipped. Required by GPTQ, compressed-tensors
612	        # should be whatever dimension intermediate_size_per_partition is
613	        is_transposed = getattr(param, "is_transposed", False)
614	
615	        # compressed-tensors checkpoints with packed weights are stored flipped
616	        # TODO (mgoin): check self.quant_method.quant_config.quant_format
617	        # against known CompressionFormat enum values that have this quality
618	        if quant_method_name in (
619	            "CompressedTensorsWNA16MoEMethod",
620	            "CompressedTensorsWNA16RDNA3MoEMethod",
621	            "CompressedTensorsW4A16FlydslMoEMethod",
622	        ):
623	            if is_transposed:
624	                loaded_weight = loaded_weight.t().contiguous()
625	            else:
626	                loaded_weight = loaded_weight
627	
628	        if shard_id not in ("w1", "w2", "w3"):
629	            raise ValueError(f"shard_id must be ['w1','w2','w3'] but got {shard_id}.")
630	
631	        # Fetch the dim to shard the parameter/loaded weight
632	        # based on the shard id. This will be whatever
633	        # dimension intermediate_size_per_partition is used.
634	        SHARD_ID_TO_SHARDED_DIM = {"w1": 0, "w2": 1, "w3": 0}
635	        shard_dim = SHARD_ID_TO_SHARDED_DIM[shard_id]
636	        if is_transposed:
637	            shard_dim = int(not shard_dim)
638	
639	        full_load = len(loaded_weight.shape) == 3
640	        if full_load:
641	            shard_dim += 1
642	
643	        expert_data = param.data if full_load else param.data[expert_id]
644	
645	        if "bias" in weight_name:
646	            self._loaded_expert_biases.add(weight_name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1])
647	            if shard_id == "w2":
648	                expert_data = self._narrow_expert_data_for_padding(
649	                    expert_data,
650	                    loaded_weight,
651	                    hidden_dim=0,
652	                )
653	                expert_data.copy_(loaded_weight)
654	            else:
655	                self._load_w13(
656	                    shard_id=shard_id,
657	                    shard_dim=0,
658	                    loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
659	                    expert_data=expert_data,
660	                    tp_rank=self.moe_config.tp_rank,
661	                )
662	            return True if return_success else None
663	
664	        # Case input scale: input_scale loading is only supported for fp8
665	        if "input_scale" in weight_name:
666	            # this is needed for compressed-tensors only
667	            loaded_weight = loaded_weight.to(param.data.device)
668	
669	            # ModelOpt NVFP4 stores w13 input scales as two logical shards.
670	            # The generic assignment below would broadcast w1/w3 into the
671	            # whole expert row, so the second shard would overwrite the first.
672	            if (
673	                "ModelOpt" in quant_method_name
674	                and param.data.ndim == 2
675	                and shard_id in ("w1", "w3")
676	            ):
677	                scale_expert_id = global_expert_id if use_global_sf else expert_id
678	                scale_shard_id = 0 if shard_id == "w1" else 1
679	                param.data[scale_expert_id][scale_shard_id] = self._to_scalar(
680	                    loaded_weight
681	                )
682	                return True if return_success else None
683	
684	            if (
685	                "compressed" in quant_method_name.lower()
686	                and param.data[expert_id] != 1
687	                and (param.data[expert_id] - loaded_weight).abs() > 1e-5
688	            ):
689	                raise ValueError(
690	                    "input_scales of w1 and w3 of a layer "
691	                    f"must be equal. But got {param.data[expert_id]} "
692	                    f"vs. {loaded_weight}"
693	                )
694	
695	            self._load_single_value(
696	                param=param,
697	                loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
698	                expert_id=global_expert_id if use_global_sf else expert_id,
699	            )
700	            return True if return_success else None
701	
702	        # TODO @dsikka: ModelOpt should follow the proper MoE loading pattern
703	        if "ModelOpt" in quant_method_name:
704	            # Determine per-tensor weight scale patterns based on variant
705	            # Use the dedicated method instead of brittle string matching
706	            uses_weight_scale_2 = self.quant_method.uses_weight_scale_2_pattern()
707	            quant_method = getattr(param, "quant_method", None)
708	
709	            # Call _load_per_tensor_weight_scale() to load per-tensor (scalar)
710	            # weights scales.
711	            # Input scales are always per-tensor.
712	            # Weight scales: FP4 uses "weight_scale_2" and FP8 uses
713	            # "weight_scale" for per-tensor scales.
714	            # NOTE: ModelOpt MXFP8 MoE uses block scales in weight_scale
715	            # tensors (quant_method=BLOCK), so those must not be treated
716	            # as per-tensor scalars here.
717	            is_block_weight_scale = (
718	                "weight_scale" in weight_name
719	                and quant_method == FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.BLOCK.value
720	            )
721	            is_per_tensor = (
722	                "weight_scale_2" in weight_name
723	                if uses_weight_scale_2
724	                else "weight_scale" in weight_name
725	            ) or "input_scale" in weight_name
726	            is_per_tensor = is_per_tensor and not is_block_weight_scale
727	            if is_per_tensor:
728	                self._load_per_tensor_weight_scale(
729	                    shard_id=shard_id,
730	                    param=param,
731	                    loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
732	                    expert_id=expert_id,
733	                )
734	                return True if return_success else None
735	
736	            # If the weight is w13_weight_scale and w13_weight_scales are
737	            # combined into single loaded_weight, call
738	            # _load_combined_w13_weight_scale() to load it.
739	            # This is checked by comparing the hidden_out dims of the
740	            # loaded_weight and the param.
741	            if "w13_weight_scale" in weight_name:
742	                loaded_weight_hidden_out = loaded_weight.shape[-2]
743	                param_hidden_out = param.data.shape[-2] * self.moe_config.tp_size
744	                if loaded_weight_hidden_out == param_hidden_out:
745	                    self._load_combined_w13_weight_scale(
746	                        shard_dim=shard_dim,
747	                        loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
748	                        param=expert_data,
749	                        tp_rank=self.moe_config.tp_rank,
750	                    )
751	                    return True if return_success else None
752	
753	            # For other weights, call _load_model_weight_or_group_weight_scale()
754	            # to load it.
755	            if "weight" in weight_name:
756	                self._load_model_weight_or_group_weight_scale(
757	                    shard_id=shard_id,
758	                    shard_dim=shard_dim,
759	                    loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
760	                    expert_data=expert_data,
761	                    tp_rank=self.moe_config.tp_rank,
762	                )
763	            return True if return_success else None
764	
765	        # Case weight scales, zero_points and offset, weight/input global scales
766	        if "scale" in weight_name or "zero" in weight_name or "offset" in weight_name:
767	            # load the weight scales and zp based on the quantization scheme
768	            # supported weight scales/zp can be found in
769	            # FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported
770	            # TODO @dsikka: once hardened, refactor to use vLLM Parameters
771	            # specific to each case
772	            quant_method = getattr(param, "quant_method", None)
773	            if quant_method == FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.CHANNEL.value:
774	                self._load_per_channel_weight_scale(
775	                    shard_id=shard_id,
776	                    shard_dim=shard_dim,
777	                    loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
778	                    expert_data=expert_data,
779	                    tp_rank=self.moe_config.tp_rank,
780	                )
781	            elif quant_method in [
782	                FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.GROUP.value,
783	                FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.BLOCK.value,
784	            ]:
785	                scale_refine = getattr(self.quant_method, "weight_scale_refine", None)
786	                if (
787	                    quant_method == FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.BLOCK.value
788	                    and scale_refine is not None
789	                ):
790	                    # FP8 block scales are stored per (block_n, block_k) tile
791	                    # of the unsharded weight, while the TP-sharded parameters
792	                    # use a refined block grid (see Fp8MoEMethod). Upsample the
793	                    # scales to the refined grid (lossless: the refined block
794	                    # divides the checkpoint block) so per-rank slicing stays
795	                    # exact. Dim -2 is the weight's N dim, dim -1 is K.
796	                    loaded_weight = loaded_weight.repeat_interleave(
797	                        scale_refine[0], dim=-2
798	                    ).repeat_interleave(scale_refine[1], dim=-1)
799	                self._load_model_weight_or_group_weight_scale(
800	                    shard_id=shard_id,
801	                    shard_dim=shard_dim,
802	                    loaded_weight=loaded_weight,
803	                    expert_data=expert_data,
804	                    tp_rank=self.moe_config.tp_rank,
805	                )
806	            elif quant_method == FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.TENSOR.value:

969	        # These loaders index ``params_dict[full_name]``, so both sides get it.

993	        """

995

999	        Args:
1000	            ckpt_gate_proj_name: Name of gate projection in checkpoint
1001	            ckpt_down_proj_name: Name of down projection in checkpoint
1002	            ckpt_up_proj_name: Name of up projection in checkpoint
1003	            num_experts: Number of logical (non-redundant) experts
1004	            num_redundant_experts: Number of redundant experts
1005	            lora_base_layer_prefix: LoRA ``base_layer.`` prefix for the
1006	                ``weight_name`` (checkpoint) side
1007	            lora_base_layer_prefix_on_param_name: same, for the ``param_name``
1008	                side. Independent because ``get_expert_mapping`` resolves
1009	                ``param_name`` via ``getattr`` against this layer's bare
1010	                ``w13_weight``/``w2_weight`` (no prefix), while
1011	                ``make_expert_params_mapping`` indexes the model-wide
1012	                ``params_dict`` (prefix included).
1013	            include_fused: Prepend the fused pre-fused-checkpoint entries

1016	            List of tuples (param_name, weight_name, expert_id, shard_id)
1017	            where:

1019	            - weight_name: Weight name in checkpoint

1021	            - shard_id: Shard identifier (w1, w2, w3)

1027	        # - `weight_name` contains the weight name of the logical expert

1035	        if routed_experts_prefix != "":

1038	        w13 = (
1039	            f"experts.{lora_base_layer_prefix_on_param_name}{routed_experts_prefix}w13_"
1040	        )

1097	        def _maybe_make_contiguous(
1098	            name: str, p: torch.nn.Parameter
1099	        ) -> torch.nn.Parameter:
1100	            """
1101	            In some cases, the last 2 dimensions (the non-expert dimensions)
1102	            of the weight scale tensor are transposed. This function
1103	            transforms the tensor (view update) so the tensor is contiguous().
1104	            Example: A non-contiguous scale tensor,
1105	              `x` of shape (E, 32, 16) and stride (512, 1, 32) is transformed to
1106	              `x_` of shape (E, 16, 32) and stride (512, 32, 1).
1107	              Note that we specifically use torch.transpose() so `x_` refers
1108	              to the same underlying memory. The tensors `x` and `x_`, pointing
1109	              to the same underlying memory make this transformation safe in the
1110	              context of EPLB. i.e. It is the same memory and just the view
1111	              is different.
1112	            Note: This function handles the "weight_scale" tensors specifically.
1113	            This could however be generalized to handle similar tensors.
1114	            """
1115	            if p.ndim != 3:
1116	                return p
1117	            if p.is_contiguous():
1118	                # Already contiguous. do nothing.
1119	                return p
1120	            # p is non-contiguous. We only handle the case where the last 2
1121	            # dimensions of the scales tensor is transposed. We can handle
1122	            # other cases when they become relevant.
1123	            is_transposed_12 = p.stride(1) == 1 and p.stride(2) != 1
1124	            if "weight_scale" not in name or not is_transposed_12:
1125	                # do nothing.
1126	                return p
1127	
1128	            # Do not update the layer parameter as the layer's MoE operations would
1129	            # expect the parameter's tensor to the same shape / stride. Instead,
1130	            # make a new torch.nn.Parameter that is used just in the context of
1131	            # EPLB.
1132	            return torch.nn.Parameter(
1133	                torch.transpose(p.data, 1, 2), requires_grad=False
1134	            )
1135	
1136	        weights = list(self.named_parameters())
1137	        weights = [(name, _maybe_make_contiguous(name, p)) for name, p in weights]
1138	
1139	        # `w13_input_scale` and `w2_input_scale` are global per-tensor
1140	        # activation scales shared across all experts (e.g. NVFP4).
1141	        # They are broadcast views (stride 0) from .expand() and are
1142	        # not actual expert weights, so exclude them from EPLB.
1143	        NON_EXPERT_WEIGHTS = {

1145	            "w13_input_scale",
1146	            "w2_input_scale",
1147	            "hash_indices_table",
1148	        }

1161	        return [

1163	            for name, weight in weights

367	            weight_shape=layer.weight.shape,

375	    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
376	        if is_weights_pre_processed():
377	            # Weights are already in runtime format; the only state tensor
378	            # export cannot carry is the `input_scale = None` stamp that dynamic
379	            # activation quantization relies on, since create_weights never
380	            # registered that parameter.
381	            if not self.act_q_static and not hasattr(layer, "input_scale"):
382	                layer.input_scale = None
383	            # Marlin reads marlin_input_dtype in apply_weights; it lives on the
384	            # method (not exported with the weights), so restore it here too.
385	            if self.use_marlin and hasattr(self.fp8_linear, "marlin_input_dtype"):
386	                self.fp8_linear.marlin_input_dtype = self.marlin_input_dtype
387	            return
388	
389	        if self.use_marlin:
390	            if not self.block_quant:
391	                # Canonicalize to (K, N) for the kernel.
392	                replace_parameter(layer, "weight", layer.weight.t())
393	            # Only Marlin kernels support `marlin_input_dtype`; guard to avoid
394	            # AttributeError if backend selection changes.
395	            if hasattr(self.fp8_linear, "marlin_input_dtype"):
396	                self.fp8_linear.marlin_input_dtype = self.marlin_input_dtype
397	            self.fp8_linear.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
398	            return
399	
400	        input_scale = None
401	        # TODO(rob): refactor block quant into separate class.
402	        if self.block_quant:
403	            assert not self.act_q_static
404	
405	        # If checkpoint not serialized fp8, quantize the weights.
406	        else:
407	            # If checkpoint is fp8 per-tensor, handle that there are N scales for N
408	            # shards in a fused module
409	            weight = layer.weight
410	            weight_scale = layer.weight_scale
411	
412	            # If using w8a8, torch._scaled_mm needs per tensor, so
413	            # requantize the logical shards as a single weight.
414	            weight, weight_scale, input_scale = process_fp8_weight_tensor_strategy(
415	                weight,
416	                weight_scale,
417	                layer.logical_widths,
418	                getattr(layer, "input_scale", None),
419	            )
420	            if self.act_q_static:
421	                assert input_scale is not None
422	                input_scale = input_scale.max()
423	            weight = weight.t()
424	
425	            # Update layer with new values.
426	            replace_parameter(layer, "weight", weight.data)
427	            replace_parameter(layer, "weight_scale", weight_scale.data)
428	
429	        if input_scale is not None:
430	            replace_parameter(layer, "input_scale", input_scale)
431	        else:
432	            layer.input_scale = None
433	
434	        self.fp8_linear.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
